row.evidence: ThreatConnect's v3 API reference lists /v3/security/users for creating, updating and deleting users (Organization Administrator API users only) and no SCIM endpoint; the knowledge base mentions SAML-enabled instances but documents no SCIM provisioning.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5): developer docs available-endpoints list, the knowledge-base sitemap and llms.txt (710 articles, no SCIM or provisioning article) and the v3 users reference were checked. ThreatConnect is now part of Dataminr: threatconnect.com and its pricing URL 301 to dataminr.com, which blocks automated fetches, and no public pricing exists (quote-only). SAML SSO exists on some instances (knowledge base), but the plan that includes it is not public. User lifecycle can be scripted through the v3 REST users API (create, update incl. disabled flag, delete).

auth.notes: Calls are made as a dedicated API user; user management needs the Organization Administrator role on that API user.

limitations.text: Bulk user deletion is not supported.
API users cannot create, update or delete users whose System role is Administrator, Community Leader, Operations Administrator or Super User.
